function: LLM-prompted search for joint UAV deployment and radar/communication power control, trading off network utility against localization CRB in UAV-enabled ISAC (pp. 1-3).
system: K=2 UAVs with ISAC units as distributed MIMO radar, M=4 ground users, FDMA, LoS free-space links, 51.2 MHz per UAV; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 2, 4).
method: Pretrained GPT-3.5 Turbo as black-box crossover/mutation operator in MOEA/D, prompted with in-context points and objective values; no training or fine-tuning (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulator: LoS free-space channel, users uniform in 2 km x 2 km, RCS uniform in [0.8, 1]; no dataset, no training data (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: No training stage; one setting only: K=2 UAVs, M=4 users, H=100 m, N=50 population, 260 iterations, GPT-3.5 Turbo (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned MOEAs only: RVEA, MOEAD, AGE-MOEA, NSGAII, MODEA; no earlier learned or LLM-based method compared (p. 4).
metrics: Hypervolume (HV) versus evaluations, Pareto fronts of network utility versus localization CRB, UAV locations and powers along the front (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Only O(2 x N x n_o) for reference-point and neighbour updates per iteration, from [3]; LLM cost not analysed, no runtime reported (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "the free-space path loss model"; the channel is a custom LoS model, with no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel, so the criterion is not met.
q2_support: p. 4: "assumed as K = 2. The number of ground users is assumed as M = 4"; a single configuration is simulated and no new scenario, band or configuration is tested (the GPT-3.0 and GPT-4.0 tests use the same problem).
q3_support: p. 4: "baseline algorithms for comparison, including RVEA [4], MOEAD [3], AGE-MOEA [4], NSGAII [4], and MODEA [5]"; all are non-learned, and no earlier learned or LLM-based method is compared, so the learned baseline is missing.
q4_support: p. 4: "we can only provide the computational analysis of updating reference points and neighbor solutions in each iteration"; the order O(2 x N x n_o) covers only that step, the cost of the LLM is not reported, and no runtime is given.
q5_support: p. 4: "randomly and uniformly distributed in an area of 2 km"; the users are drawn in a custom simulator, there is no public channel dataset, and no code or data link appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: Borderline for no_learning: GPT-3.5 Turbo is pretrained and used only through prompts, with no training or fine-tuning (p. 4); included because the LLM generates every candidate UAV position and power (p. 3), so a learned component produces the physical-layer decisions. The reviewer may reclassify it as no_learning. UAV deployment is above the physical layer but is optimized jointly with power control, so above_phy does not apply (p. 2). Area 6 over 5 by the tie-break order (aerial link that also senses). q4 is 0 because the only order given, O(2 x N x n_o), covers the update step and the paper says that the cost of the LLM is not analysed (p. 4); a reviewer who accepts a partial order would mark q4 as 1. The PDF is arXiv 2410.05062v2 of 26 Nov 2024 and prints no DOI; its title and first authors match the Crossref record of the DOI. All five marks are 0.
